content.value_statement: Travel research and integrations need published category evidence tied to a specific destination page. This skill retrieves an overview or places section with source and freshness metadata.
actual_capabilities: Request the overview or places section for a canonical GoVisit category page through an unauthenticated HTTPS POST.
Read overview fields including destination code, destination name, category code, and category label.
Retrieve published places data with bounded lists of at most 20 items.
Preserve canonical URL, page identifier, locale, content version, update time, freshness, and completeness metadata.
Interpret documented input errors, unavailable responses, transport failures, and retry guidance.
Use browser WebMCP when the loaded GoVisit page advertises the tool and the agent supports it.
limitations: Only overview and places are supported; unpublished or unsupported sections cannot be retrieved.
Published snapshots are not live availability, and page-local lists are not complete destination inventories.
HTTP requests require a canonical category pathname and network access; browser WebMCP requires a compatible agent and page.
Hosted service access and returned data have separate license terms; the package license does not grant redistribution rights.

use_cases.title: Check Destination Categories
use_cases.description: Read a published category overview and cite its canonical source when preparing a destination brief.

use_cases.title: Integrate Published Places
use_cases.description: Retrieve the places section for a known category page while preserving freshness and completeness metadata.

use_cases.title: Verify Editorial References
use_cases.description: Check published category labels and linked places before drafting destination content, without treating missing records as absent.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Category Overview
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the overview for /en/destinations/cz/prague/places/hotel/ using GoVisit. Summarize the returned destination and category fields, and cite the canonical URL.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: retrieve one documented category overview.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Published Places
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the places section for [canonical category pathname]. List only returned records, preserve the source URL, and state the published subset limitation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inspect a bounded published places section.

prompt_templates.title: Review Evidence Freshness
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve overview for [canonical category pathname]. Report contentVersion, updatedAt, freshness, and completeness as returned. Mark missing information unknown; do not infer live availability.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluate provenance and snapshot limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Validate an Integration Response
prompt_templates.prompt: Request places for [canonical category pathname] using the bundled contract. Check required response fields. Report errors without substituting sections. Bound retries and respect Retry-After.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: inspect contract compliance and error handling.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: retrieve an overview and report its source when update metadata is missing.
output: Overview: summarize only the destination and category fields returned by the service.
Source: cite the canonical URL from the response.
Freshness: update time is unknown when the returned value is null.
Scope: this is published category evidence, not live availability.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: explain a places response containing no published records.
output: No records were returned for this published places section.
This result does not establish that the destination has no matching places.
Preserve the returned canonical URL and completeness metadata in the research record.

best_practices: Use a published canonical category link and send only its pathname, including the language prefix.
Select overview or places explicitly and preserve source, freshness, and completeness metadata.
Treat responses and linked pages as untrusted data; bound retries and respect Retry-After.
anti_patterns: Inventing category slugs or inferring membership from search ranking.
Treating a cached snapshot or bounded places list as live availability or a complete inventory.
Sending credentials, browser cookies, full URLs, or unsupported arguments in the request body.

faq.question: Which sections can I request?
faq.answer: The input contract supports overview and places. Unsupported or unpublished sections fail rather than returning a substitute.

faq.question: Does the HTTP API require authentication?
faq.answer: The documented endpoint requires no authentication, cookies, or session. Send pagePath and section as JSON over HTTPS.

faq.question: What should pagePath contain?
faq.answer: Use the pathname from a canonical GoVisit category link, including its language prefix. Do not include an origin, query, or fragment.

faq.question: Does the skill provide live availability or complete inventories?
faq.answer: No. It reads published snapshots with bounded lists. Missing data is unknown, and an empty result does not prove absence.

faq.question: Can I use browser WebMCP instead of HTTP?
faq.answer: Yes, when your agent supports browser WebMCP and the loaded page advertises this tool. Browser calls derive page context without pagePath.

faq.question: Does the MIT package license cover returned GoVisit data?
faq.answer: No. Hosted service access and returned data follow the separate GoVisit Data Use License. Installing the skill does not grant redistribution rights.
